title: Intra-Day Momentum
one_line: In US stocks (1993-2010) the 15:30-16:00 return is positively related to the 9:30-12:00 return, while the 13:30-15:30 return reverses the morning; the last half-hour is the strongest intraday slot (+8.9%/yr) and the first hour the weakest; all gross.

findings.statement: 9:30-12:00 winners/losers both positive in 15:30-16:00; 13:30-15:30 return negatively related to the morning.
Morning winner/loser spread flipped sign after 2001 decimalization.

why.pattern: Institutional order splitting and end-of-day rebalancing.
